thread:
Maya: Heads up — Netscribe wants their Dedicated pool to automatically spillover to eu-west when us-east is saturated, but only for burst windows and only if data residency flag = false.
Jordan: Hmm. We have fallback routing now but not region-aware contracts. Need policy for quotas + SLA implications.
Eli: Key asks: 1) hard cap per region, 2) priority routing for reserved tenants, 3) prewarm signal to spin up region GPUs earlier (they want <500ms p95).
Samir: On infra: prewarm 15m notice for GPU allocation increases latency of start up — depends on instance types. Can we do prefix-caching to reduce cold penalty?
Jordan: Suggestion: soft-spill: allow burst jobs to route to secondary region only if primary's queued requests > 90% for > 30s AND tenant has opted-in. Fallback model = same model family, quantized if needed.
Maya: Customer requires audit logs and opt-in toggle.
Eli: Launch criteria proposal: 1) routing policy implemented 2) observability — cross-region latency + cost per token 3) contract language for data residency + fallback opt-in 4) canary with 2 customers.
Samir: Ops considerations: prewarm window config: default 30m, min 5m; on-prem/hybrid can't spill. Also cost flags to bill spillover usage at same rate or premium?
Jordan: Pricing: prefer premium 1.5x to discourage unnecessary spillover. Product to validate.
Maya: I'll draft customer-facing doc and contract language. Action: @Eli to spec routing policy; @Samir to estimate infra cost and prewarm times; @Jordan to model pricing impact.
Eli: For routing policy spec — quick snippet:
```yaml
spillover:
  enabled: true
  opt_in: tenant_flag
  primary_region: us-east
  secondary_regions: [eu-west, ap-south]
  trigger:
    queue_pct: 0.9
    sustained_secs: 30
  prewarm:
    default: 1800 # seconds
    min: 300
  billing:
    rate_multiplier: 1.5
```
Samir: Note: prewarm should support incremental pre-allocation (partial GPU). Also, fallthrough should respect model-variant compatibility.
Jordan: QA: test scenarios — sudden spike, gradual ramp, region outage. Oncall playbook update.
Maya: Timeline: aim for pilot end of Q2. Can we have a minimal MVP by end of next sprint? (2 weeks) Probably need to scope down: MVP = opt-in spillover to single secondary region, no pricing change, metrics + logs.
Eli: Agree on MVP scope.
Samir: I'll spin up a perf test and share numbers.
Jordan: I'll book a 30min follow-up sync Wed 10am. @Maya please send invite.
Maya: Sent. Thanks all. /cc @ops-bot (deployed:link) (reaction :sparkles:)
